filter.basis_one: Showing the {count} person without a lawful basis.

filter.expired_other: Showing the {count} people whose invitations expired.

filter.noInvoices: Nobody gets invoices & reminders: give a contact with an e-mail the role Invoices.

people.title: People
people.info: Gets by e-mail: who our mails go to by default. Quotes and order confirmations go to the oldest Orders contact with an e-mail; shipping notices to every Orders contact; delay notices to up to 3 of them; invoices, reminders and statements to every Invoices contact; deposit pages to the first Invoices contact, else Orders; recall notices to the Quality contact.
people.infoQuote: A quote's own contact wins for its own mails (its confirmation, its deposit page, its delay notice). A portal person who is no contact gets only what their portal settings say.

answer.none: Nobody yet: add the person who orders — quotes and confirmations go to them.
answer.allTo: quotes, confirmations, invoices and reminders go to {name}
answer.portalHidden: portal access is not shown for your role
answer.portalOff: the portal is off for this customer

people.sameName: Same name as the contact {name}: check the e-mail
people.tick: Tick portal people to act on many…

gets.noEmail: Gets nothing: no e-mail. Orders, invoices and quality mails need one.
gets.portalOnly: Not a contact: gets no mail by role. Portal notices follow their own settings.

row.erasedHeld: This contact was erased: nothing more can be done with it.

held.noEmailInvite: An invitation needs an e-mail: add it to the contact first.

bulk.label: Acts on the ticked portal people
bulk.none: Tick the portal people to act on together

addresses.info: Defaults: a new quote and a new order start with the default address for invoices and for deliveries. The e-invoices name the oldest active registered office (else the default address for invoices).
addresses.infoCheck: An address the customer adds in the portal waits for our check: it is not used for deliveries until a colleague who manages orders approves it. Refuse it with the words the customer reads.

answer.none: No address yet: invoices name the registered office; deliveries go to the default delivery address.
answer.noDeliveries: no default for deliveries: new orders ask for one
answer.registered: {count} registered offices: e-invoices use the oldest

addresses.otherRegistered: Also a registered office, but e-invoices use the oldest one ({city}). Archive the one that is no longer right.

address.waitingHeld: It waits for our check: it can be a default once it is approved.
address.refusedHeld: A refused address never changes: the customer can add another.

check.label: Check of {name}
check.added: added in the portal by {name} on {date}
check.notUsed: Not used for deliveries until it is approved; it cannot be a default before.
check.colleague: A colleague who manages orders approves or refuses it.
check.reason: “{reason}” — the customer reads these words. A refused address never comes back: they can add another.

refuse.title: Refuse the delivery address
refuse.sub: {customer} · added in the portal by {name} on {date}
refuse.never: A refused address never comes back and cannot be edited: the customer can add another.
refuse.noOrder: No order uses it yet: it was waiting for our check.
refuse.tooShort: Say why the address is not accepted: the customer reads it.

done.approved: The delivery address “{name}” was approved: it can be chosen for deliveries now, in the office and in the portal.
done.refused: The delivery address “{name}” was refused: the customer reads why.
done.copyFailed: Couldn't copy: select the text and copy it by hand.

keys: Keys: Tab moves to the next act, Enter or Space opens it; Esc closes a menu or a window.
